hints.title: Sign Propagation across Parentheses
hints.text: Track running cumulative total and current sign, pushing contextual signs onto a collection when entering parenthesized blocks.

hints.title: Stack Framing on Parentheses Boundaries
hints.text: On opening parenthesis, push the accumulated result and active sign. On closing parenthesis, evaluate and pop.

hints.title: Single-Pass Infix Arithmetic Evaluation
hints.text: Maintain res = 0, sign = 1, and a stack. Parse multi-digit numbers; when an operator or parenthesis arrives, add sign * num to res. On open parenthesis, push res and sign, then reset res = 0 and sign = 1. On close parenthesis, res = stack.pop() * res + stack.pop().

hints.title: See the blueprint
hints.text:
```python
class Solution:
    def calculate(self, s: str) -> int:
        stack = []
        res = 0
        num = 0
        sign = 1
        for ch in s:
            if ch.isdigit():
                num = num * 10 + int(ch)
            elif ch in "+-":
                res += sign * num
                num = 0
                sign = 1 if ch == "+" else -1
            elif ch == "(":
                stack.append(res)
                stack.append(sign)
                res = 0
                sign = 1
            elif ch == ")":
                res += sign * num
                num = 0
                res *= stack.pop()  # sign
                res += stack.pop()  # previous res
        res += sign * num
        return res
```

complexity.notes: Optimal linear arithmetic parsing with stack-bounded parenthesis depths.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Recursively parsing subexpressions by copying substrings incurs quadratic O(N^2) memory.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: A single stack tracking result and sign frames enables linear single-pass evaluation.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Accumulate numbers continuously and handle unary/binary signs across nested parentheses.
